decided: The detail of each session record (its fields, their shapes, and when each conditional field is owed) moves out of the skill bodies into a reference file that every session reads before writing its first record; if a session skips that read, a conditional field it never learned of is left out and nothing reports the loss, except a missing consent field, which the drift check already flags.
alternatives: keep in each body one line per conditional field saying when it is owed, and read the reference only when one is owed
keep those lines in apply's body only, and read the reference in every other skill
why: The read comes at the one moment every session reaches, where the agent needs the fields to write anything, so it asks for no judgement; the text keeps a single home instead of a second copy of its triggers that could drift; and the bodies shrink the most.

defines.definition: the JSON summary each orbit command writes about its session, through orbit emit
a field of that record owed only when something happened earlier in the session, such as a decision to proceed past an unpassed review
orbit's audit-drift command, which scans the project for records and documents that disagree
a file beside a skill's body that the agent reads only when the body tells it to
